answer_text:
# 🏥 Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist — **wakehealth.edu**

**[wakehealth.edu](https://www.wakehealth.edu)** is the official website of **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a major academic medical health system based in **Winston-Salem, North Carolina**. Here's an overview:

---

## 🏨 The Medical Center
Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center offers expert medical care and advanced treatments in Winston-Salem, NC. Some of its key specialty areas include:

- Comprehensive Cancer Center, Heart and Vascular Center, Orthopaedic Services, Neurology and Neurosurgery, Pediatrics, and Primary Care.
- Orthopaedic surgeons and specialists treat every type of orthopaedic condition with advanced techniques and research-based approaches.
- Experts include more than 150 pediatricians and pediatric surgeons specializing in more than 30 areas of pediatric medicine and surgery.

---

## 🎓 School of Medicine (school.wakehealth.edu)
Wake Forest University School of Medicine directs the education of nearly 1,900 students and fellows, including physicians, basic scientists, and allied clinical professionals.

- The school has a nationally recognized research program, garnering over $400 million in extramural funding.
- The PA program is ranked #11 and the Nurse Anesthesia program is ranked #12 in the country.
- The School of Medicine is one of the most selective medical training programs in the nation and encompasses multiple programs, including MD, PA Studies, DNP, and biomedical graduate programs.
- With more than 100 accredited and non-accredited residencies and fellowships, Wake Forest University School of Medicine offers a wide range of options for the next step in a medical career.

---

## 📱 Patient Portal — MyAtriumHealth
The portal for Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist patients is now **MyAtriumHealth**, which provides a convenient experience to access your health information.

- You can sign in from the website or download the free MyAtriumHealth App in your App Store.
- The portal offers access to virtual care, like Symptom Checker, eVisits, Urgent Care video visits, Emergency Care video visits, and more.

---

## 🔍 Find a Doctor
With online doctor appointments and physicians in Winston-Salem, NC & surrounding areas, they make it easy to find care close to home.

---

## 📰 Latest News
Hugh Chatham Health has officially joined Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist.
